exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.instructions: Hold a band in front of your chest with your arms straight and hands shoulder-width apart. Pull the band apart until it touches your chest. Return slowly.

exercises.name: Band face pull
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band at head height and hold an end in each hand. Pull towards your face, spreading your hands apart. Return slowly.

exercises.name: Seated band row
exercises.instructions: Sit with your legs straight and loop a band around your feet. Pull the ends towards your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades together. Return slowly.

exercises.name: Kneeling band pulldown
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band overhead and kneel facing it, holding an end in each hand. Pull your elbows down to your sides. Let your arms rise slowly.

exercises.name: Band chest press
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height and hold an end in each hand. Press your hands forward until your arms are straight. Return slowly.

exercises.name: Band overhead press
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band and hold the ends at shoulder height. Press them overhead until your arms are straight. Lower them slowly to your shoulders.

exercises.name: Band lateral raise
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band and hold an end in each hand at your sides. Raise your arms out to shoulder height. Lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Band biceps curl
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band and hold the ends with your palms facing forward. Curl your hands towards your shoulders. Lower them slowly.

exercises.name: Band triceps pressdown
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band overhead and hold the ends with your elbows at your sides. Push down until your arms are straight. Let your hands rise slowly.

exercises.name: Band squat
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ends at your shoulders. Squat down, then stand up against the band. Keep your heels down throughout.

exercises.name: Band good morning
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band and loop the other end across your upper back. Hinge forward with a flat back. Stand back up by driving your hips forward.

exercises.name: Banded glute bridge
exercises.instructions: Lie on your back with a loop band just above your knees, knees bent and feet flat. Press your knees out against the band and lift your hips. Lower slowly.

exercises.name: Banded lateral walk
exercises.instructions: Place a loop band around your legs above your knees and bend your knees slightly. Step sideways, keeping tension on the band. Log the steps taken in each direction.

exercises.name: Band-assisted pull-up
exercises.instructions: Loop a band over a pull-up bar and place a foot or knee in it. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar. Lower yourself slowly.

exercises.name: Band Pallof press
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band at chest height and stand side-on, holding it at your chest. Press it straight out without letting your torso turn. Bring it back and complete one side before switching.

exercises.name: Band deadlift
exercises.instructions: Stand on a band and hold the ends with your arms straight. Hinge to lower your hands towards your shins, then stand up tall. Keep your back flat throughout.

exercises.name: Band external rotation
exercises.instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height and stand side-on, holding it in your far hand with the elbow bent and tucked in. Rotate your forearm outwards. Return slowly and complete one side before switching.
